entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature

Mass 0.542101 +/- 0.020298 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of Kepler-125 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). Temperature 3810 +/- 150 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-125 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,810 K and log g 4.75 (u1 0.419, u2 0.331): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
